summary: Verified iteration 2 bug-fix items: (1) POST /api/notes/bulk-delete backend endpoint, (2) frontend multi-select checkboxes + bulk toolbar + 'Elimina selezionate', (3) 'Invia tramite Gmail' opens new tab with correct compose URL. All items pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: except clause on PDF storage failure catches all Exceptions and silently sets pdf_path=''; ok for MVP but log line already present. Fine.
App.js is ~525 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting NoteCard, PhotoManager, PdfUploader into separate files if the app grows.

sendGmail: anchor click approach works and passes URL check; note that in browsers without an active Google session the URL first redirects to accounts.google.com signin with the compose URL in `continue=` — that is Google's own behavior, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Tests upload /tmp/sample.pdf (OpenFiber PDF) and clean up their own notes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_delete.py (3 tests, all pass). Frontend Playwright verified: (a) select-note-<wr> checkboxes toggle selection & do NOT expand card, (b) bulk-toolbar with select-all-checkbox / selection-count / bulk-delete-button all functional (disabled when 0 selected, calls /api/notes/bulk-delete on confirm, toast 'N nota/note eliminate', selection cleared, list refreshed), (c) send-gmail-button opens a new tab whose (possibly redirected) URL contains https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm with fs=1, tf=1, to= with all 5 recipients (comma-joined and URL-encoded), su=WR%3A%20<code>, body=<encoded note>. Regression on PDF parse + single delete still works (used implicitly by tests).
rca of the issue: N/A — verifying already-applied fixes; both bugs are fixed.
